scope: article, publication, announcement, and release-oriented human-facing delivery
rule: Before any repository mutation or external publication effect for a newly requested article/publication package, deliver the requested human-readable Markdown as one contiguous copyable block in the active terminal/chat surface.
exceptions: emergency fail-closed action required to prevent an already-authorized unsafe effect
evidence_boundary: The copy artifact is a human-delivery requirement, not proof of publication, merge, deployment, or external effect.

product_owner_authorization.statement: Zuerst einen vollständig kopierbaren Markdown-Artikel im Chat liefern; danach erst die restlichen Repository- und Publikationsaufgaben ausführen.
